Class FineCalculator

java.lang.Object
FineCalculator
public class FineCalculator extends Object
Calculates fines for overdue media items using a flexible strategy.

The FineCalculator uses the Strategy design pattern to apply different fine calculation strategies. You can change the strategy at runtime using setFineStrategy(FineStrategy).
